short_name: iNKT cells are a rare population of lymphocytes
quote: Frequencies of peripheral iNKT cells vary substantially but are usually low ranging from undetectable up to 1% of lymphocytes (14,15).

short_name: Vδ2+Vγ9+ cells are the largest peripheral γδ subset
expected: a higher frequency than the Vδ1+Vγ9− subset
quote: The majority of Vδ2+ T cells co-express Vγ9 and form the largest population of peripheral γδ T cells, while Vδ1+ T cells dominate mucosal tissues.

short_name: Two levels of Vδ2 exist within the Vδ2+Vγ9+ subset
expected: two levels of Vδ2 within Vδ2+Vγ9+ cells
quote: Interestingly, two populations within Vδ2+Vγ9+ T cells exist with distinct expression levels of Vδ2 (Vδ2lowVγ9+ and Vδ2highVγ9+) (Fig. 1C) (23).

short_name: MAIT cells carry Vα7.2 and high CD161
expected: a resolvable Vα7.2+ CD161 high population inside the double negative T cells
quote: MAIT cells are characterized by the expression of TCR Vα7.2 and high levels of CD161 (Fig. 1C) (11,24).

short_name: Conventional T cells are the majority of CD3+ cells
expected: more than half of CD3+ cells after the unconventional subsets are removed
quote: The remaining cells after exclusion of MAIT cells are conventional T cells, which mostly encompass CD4+ and CD8+ T cells (Fig. 1C).

short_name: Three NK subsets are resolvable within CD3−HLA-DR− cells
expected: three subsets separated by CD16 and CD56
quote: We distinguished three NK cell subsets within CD3−HLA-DR− cells (Fig. 1D) based on the expression of CD16 and CD56, namely early (CD56brightCD16−), mature (CD56+CD16+), and terminal (CD56−CD16+) NK cells (Fig. 1D) (9,27,28).

short_name: Mature NK cells are the largest NK population in blood
expected: a higher frequency than the early and the terminal subsets
quote: Mature NK cells form the largest NK population in peripheral blood and are characterized by cytotoxic effector functions.

expected: a detectable CD16+CD56+ fraction of γδ T cells
quote: Although we included CD16 and CD56 to define NK cell subsets, in-depth analysis revealed the existence of CD16+CD56+ γδ T cells, which are associated with immune activation (42) (Fig. 1J).

short_name: CCR7 and CD45RA split CD4 and CD8 T cells into four subsets
expected: naive TCM TEM and TEMRA resolved on CCR7 and CD45RA
quote: The inclusion of CCR7 and CD45RA enables the identification of four subsets (first column), namely CD45RA+CCR7+ naïve, CCR7+CD45RA− central memory (TCM), CCR7−CD45RA− effector memory (TEM), and CCR7−CD45RA+ terminally differentiated memory (TEMRA) T cells within CD4+ (top row) and CD8+ (bottom row) T cells.

short_name: The panel resolves the published strategy from viable single lymphocytes
expected: every population of the published strategy reached from viable single lymphocytes
quote: The panel described here enables the in-depth characterization of NK cells and conventional and unconventional T cells using 28-color high-dimensional flow cytometry.
